summary: Create a local Nuxt Studio website with editable brand, hero, theme and feature content. Include a demo contact form; no email is sent.
assumptions: Content edits remain local until reviewed and verified.

tasks.title: Studio editable website
tasks.instructions: Preserve the Nuxt Content schema and make site content editable in Studio. Keep the demo contact form contract intact.
acceptance: Contact form validates email without sending it

test_flows.goal: The application health endpoint returns its documented JSON response.
steps: GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 and exactly {status: ok}

test_flows.goal: Contact input validation accepts a valid email and rejects invalid input.
steps: POST /api/contact with email person@example.test returns 200 and exactly {message: Thanks! Your demo enquiry is valid.}

test_flows.goal: A visitor can view the homepage and submit a valid demo contact enquiry.
steps: Expect [data-testid=contact-result] to contain Thanks! Your demo enquiry is valid.
